rationale: Append the canonical LLM_RENDERING stage to the proven real response path while reusing the existing orchestration runtime behavior that marks rendering NOT_REQUIRED when allow_llm_rendering is false. No rendering provider, response semantics, or safety policy is changed.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded. This extends only the real-stage composition surface of the governed orchestration runtime.
authority_impact: No semantic, advisory, recommendation, or rendering authority is broadened. The supplied rendering capability is not invoked when rendering is disabled, and the deterministic assembled response remains the authoritative machine response for the next stage.
